evidence: RPC/REST/ZMQ label; adds setprunelock and listprunelocks RPC methods in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Adds explicit RPC methods to manage block prune locks so external wallets can prevent necessary blocks from being deleted without relying on cumbersome manual pruning workarounds. Reviewers note that enabling external wallets to build on pruned nodes via RPC provides a clear use case.
